request.text: An implant on WORKSTATION5 registered a daily scheduled task that runs a hidden PowerShell payload stored in the registry. Contain host WORKSTATION5.theshire.local.

package.rationale: pgustavo's PowerShell (PID 7312) opened and started schtasks.exe /Create /SC DAILY /TN MordorSchtask with an action that runs a hidden PowerShell decoding a payload from the HKCU registry, and the task file C:\Windows\System32\Tasks\MordorSchtask was written. This is scheduled-task persistence of an implant on WORKSTATION5; isolate the host now.

permitted.note: rule A rule 2: WORKSTATION5.theshire.local is the request's host; policy P2-tier12-isolate; fulfils the request
